import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from catboost import CatBoostClassifier

# Set random state for reproducibility
RANDOM_STATE = 42
np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Get species column names from sample submission (columns after 'id')
species_cols = [col for col in sample_sub.columns if col != "id"]
n_classes = len(species_cols)

print(f"Number of species: {n_classes}")
print(f"Training samples: {len(train_df)}")
print(f"Test samples: {len(test_df)}")

# Identify feature columns (exclude id and species from train_df)
train_id_col = "id"
train_species_col = "species"
all_feature_cols = [
    col for col in train_df.columns if col not in [train_id_col, train_species_col]
]

print(f"Number of features: {len(all_feature_cols)}")

# Extract features and labels
X_train = train_df[all_feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
y_train = train_df[train_species_col].apply(lambda x: species_cols.index(x)).values
X_test = test_df[all_feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)

# Split training data into train/validation for hold-out evaluation
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train,
    y_train,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    stratify=y_train,
    shuffle=True,
)

print(f"Train split size: {len(X_tr)}")
print(f"Validation split size: {len(X_val)}")

# Initialize CatBoostClassifier with CORRECT parameters
model = CatBoostClassifier(
    iterations=1000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    depth=6,
    l2_leaf_reg=3,
    loss_function="MultiClass",  # Fixed: Changed from MultiClassSoftmax to MultiClass
    eval_metric="Logloss",
    verbose=False,
    task_type="CPU",
    random_seed=RANDOM_STATE,
    allow_writing_files=False,
)

# Train model on training split ONLY
print("Training model...")
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr, eval_set=(X_val, y_val), verbose=False)

# Predict on validation set and compute log-loss (competition metric)
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val)

# Normalize probabilities to sum to 1 per row (as done in actual competition scoring)
row_sum = val_probs.sum(axis=1)
val_probs_norm = val_probs / np.expand_dims(row_sum, axis=1)

# Compute log-loss (official competition metric) - no sqrt or other transformation
validation_metric = log_loss(y_val, val_probs_norm, labels=np.arange(n_classes))
print(f"Validation Metric (logloss): {validation_metric:.6f}")

# Predict on test set for submission
test_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Normalize probabilities (competition rescales them, but we do it to be safe)
row_sum_test = np.maximum(test_probs.sum(axis=1), 1e-15)
test_probs_norm = test_probs / np.expand_dims(row_sum_test, axis=1)

# Handle edge cases where normalized prob might exceed 1 due to floating point
test_probs_norm = np.clip(test_probs_norm, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Ensure all values are within valid range for log loss computation
test_probs_norm = np.where(test_probs_norm < 1e-15, 1e-15, test_probs_norm)
test_probs_norm = np.where(test_probs_norm > 1 - 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15, test_probs_norm)

# Create submission DataFrame matching sample submission format
sub_df = pd.DataFrame(test_probs_norm, columns=species_cols)
sub_df.insert(0, "id", test_df["id"])

# Save submission to required location
sub_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

# Final verification
print(f"\nSubmission shape: {sub_df.shape}")
print(f"Submission columns: {list(sub_df.columns)[:5]}...{list(sub_df.columns)[-5:]}")
print(f"Row sum check (should be ~1): {test_probs_norm.mean():.6f}")
print(
    f"Minimum probability: {test_probs_norm.min():.10f}, Maximum probability: {test_probs_norm.max():.10f}"
)
print(f"\nFinal validation logloss score: {validation_metric:.6f}")
